title: Nutella Wrap
description: A delicious gluten-free dessert or snack made with Nutella and wrapped in a crispy wrap.

ingredients.name: Nutella
ingredients.notes: Spread Nutella evenly on the wrap

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Place the wrap in the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy.
Spread 1 tablespoon of Nutella on each half of the wrap.
If using quenched, top with crushed or sliced quenched.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the Nutella and quenched (if using).
Cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, until the Nutella is melted and the wrap is crispy.
